sentences.en: Please hide the blueberry jam where Takako can't see it.
sentences.zh: 请把蓝莓果酱藏起来，让高子看不见。

sentences.en: The authorities have been hiding the facts from the public.
sentences.zh: 当局一直在向公众隐瞒事实。

sentences.en: He assumed that the man was hiding something from him.
sentences.zh: 他觉得那个人有什么事情在瞒着他。
